scientific_limitations: The orbit count is for injective ordered tuples and the canonical dyadic distance cutoff.
The factor 2^{C(n,2)} uses unrestricted graph relations and need not survive additional metric-dependent graph constraints.
The combinatorial multichain polynomial is classical in nature; the novelty claim is its exact realization as this structure's finite-resolution orbit profile.
Uncatalogued specialist folklore remains a residual originality risk.
title: Finite-resolution orbit growth of the ultrametric random graph is a partition-lattice zeta polynomial
